During these times, Blocks cannot be weakened: no deleting a Block, no removing an app or time range from one, and this schedule itself cannot be edited. Adding a new Block, or adding an app or time range to an existing one, is always allowed, any time. Outside these times, everything is open.

A Holiday Break pauses the Blocks you choose, for one specific date-and-time window you set ahead of time - as many as you want. Creating one is allowed during an unlocked Lock Schedule time, or any time if its start doesn\'t take effect until a later day (a day starts at 2:00 AM for this purpose, so 1:30 AM still counts as the day before). Cancelling one early is always allowed, any time.
This can only be created during an unlocked time, unless its start is on a later day (a day starts at 2:00 AM) - check your Lock Schedule, or pick a later start date/time.
Cancel this Holiday Break now? The affected Blocks will resume their normal schedule immediately.

Domains added here are blocked in Chrome (and every subdomain of them), pushed in as a Chrome content policy - no DNS or VPN involved. Chrome also blocks adult/explicit sites in general, forces SafeSearch and restricted YouTube, and Incognito is disabled. Every other common browser is kept permanently unusable so this can\'t just be switched around.

When turned on, Lock Schedule\'s editing-protection, all Blocks, and Alarms stop applying whenever you\'re more than 20km from the home location you set below - as if none of it existed while you\'re away. If your location can\'t be determined for any reason, everything stays exactly as it would without this feature - restrictions still apply. This never affects the permanent protections (this app can\'t be uninstalled, VPN stays blocked, other browsers stay locked, etc.) - those stay on no matter where you are.

Changing an already-set home location can only be done during an unlocked time - check your Lock Schedule. (Being far from home doesn\'t unlock this specifically - otherwise a single trip could permanently break the feature.)
